description: This file contains internal test suite management code for the Ginkgo testing framework, including definitions for test suite states, functions for discovering test suites, handling precompiled test binaries, and identifying Ginkgo test files.

classes.name: TestSuite
classes.description: Represents a test suite, including its path, package name, whether it's a Ginkgo suite, precompiled status, compilation errors, focus, and current state.

classes.name: TestSuites
classes.description: A slice of TestSuite objects with utility methods for filtering, shuffling, and querying test suites.

methods.name: AbsPath
methods.description: Returns the absolute path of the test suite.

methods.name: NamespacedName
methods.description: Returns a namespaced identifier for the test suite based on its path.

methods.name: AnyHaveProgrammaticFocus
methods.description: Checks if any test suite has programmatic focus.

methods.name: ThatAreGinkgoSuites
methods.description: Filters and returns only Ginkgo test suites.

methods.name: CountWithState
methods.description: Counts test suites with specified states.

methods.name: WithState
methods.description: Filters and returns test suites with specified states.

methods.name: WithoutState
methods.description: Filters and returns test suites not in specified states.

methods.name: ShuffledCopy
methods.description: Returns a shuffled copy of the test suites.
